summary: Enhance your skills with our Econometrics Training Course tailored for Central Bank Professionals. Gain insights and tools for effective economic analysis.
lede: Econometrics for Central Bank Professionals provides a practical toolkit for turning complex datasets into transparent, replicable, and robust evidence. You will learn to frame policy questions, choose appropriate models, test assumptions, interpret outputs, and distinguish meaningful signals from patterns that do not withstand rigorous testing. The course applies these skills to monetary policy, financial stability, exchange rate pass-through, macro-financial stress testing, and forecasting. Through hands-on work with real datasets and scenarios, you will build confidence in communicating model results and assumptions clearly to non-technical decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for central bank professionals across various functions, focusing on those who must interpret central bank data and defend findings in reports and meetings.
audience: Monetary policy and macroeconomic analysis teams
Markets and reserves management analysts (rates, FX
Data science, BI, and analytics teams
modules: Econometric Thinking for Central Bank Decisions
Data Preparation and Central Bank Data Reality
Regression Fundamentals Without the Academic Fog
Diagnosing Model Problems That Break Policy Conclusions
Time-Series Foundations for Central Bank Work
Model Risk, Stress, and Robustness Checks
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of statistics and familiarity with econometric software such as EViews, Stata, or R. Prior experience with central bank data is beneficial but not required.
